channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Sweetgreen: $3 Off Your Order via Cash App Pay
item.guid: Sweetgreen-$3 Off Your Order via Cash App Pay-2026-08-09
item.description: Opt in through Cash App, then pay with Cash App Pay in the Sweetgreen app or online to get $3 off any order — valid once per customer. (Through August 15, 2026)

item.title: Panera Bread: Mix and Match Menu — $4.99 Each
item.guid: Panera Bread-Mix and Match Menu — $4.99 Each-2026-08-09
item.description: Pick any combination of half sandwiches, half salads, or small soups from Panera's value menu at $4.99 each; minimum two items required, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Choose from 3-piece Signature Chicken, 3-piece Tenders, a Classic Chicken Sandwich, or two regular Southern-style sides for just $5 each — order in-store, online, or in-app. (Through August 30, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: 4-Piece Tenders Meal for $9.99
item.description: Get four chicken tenders, one regular side, one regular drink, and a biscuit for $9.99 — order in-store, online, or in the Popeyes app. (Through August 30, 2026)

item.title: Taco Bell: $5.99 Luxe Cravings Box
item.description: Get a Chalupa Supreme, Beefy 5-Layer Burrito, Double Stacked Taco, Chips and Nacho Cheese or Cinnamon Twists, and a medium drink for $5.99 — order in the app or online. (Ongoing)

item.title: Taco Bell: $3 Fresca Steak Burrito
item.description: Grab a Fresca Steak Burrito or Melty Pepper Jack Steak Burrito for $3 each from Taco Bell's Luxe Value Menu, available in-store, online, and in the app. (Limited time)

item.title: Wendy's: $1 Small Classic Frosty
item.description: Any guest can get a small Chocolate or Vanilla Classic Frosty for $1 at participating Wendy's locations in-restaurant, drive-thru, in-app, or on Wendys.com (delivery excluded). (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Jimmy John's: $5.99 Select 8-Inch Sandwiches
item.description: Get any 8-inch Turkey Tom, The Pepe, Vito, or The Veggie for $5.99 each for a limited time — offer does not apply to combos. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me Starting at $10.99
item.description: Dine-in guests get a non-alcoholic drink, a starter, and a choice of entree including the Big Smasher Burger for $10.99 at participating Chili's locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Dunkin': $6 Meal Deal: Coffee and 2 Wake-Up Wraps
item.guid: Dunkin'-$6 Meal Deal: Coffee and 2 Wake-Up Wraps-2026-08-09
item.description: Order a medium hot or iced coffee plus two Wake-Up Wrap Sandwiches for $6 at participating Dunkin' locations nationwide. (Ongoing)

item.title: Dunkin': 48 oz Iced Beverage Bucket for $12.99
item.guid: Dunkin'-48 oz Iced Beverage Bucket for $12.99-2026-08-09
item.description: Fill a giant 48-ounce bucket with your choice of cold beverage at Dunkin' for $12.99 while supplies last — back starting August 7. (Limited time)

item.title: Wingstop: $16.99 Boneless Meal Deal
item.description: Get 20 boneless wings in up to four flavors, a large fry, and two dips for $16.99 — order online or in the Wingstop app for pickup or delivery. (Limited time)

item.title: Domino's: Mix and Match Deal — $6.99 Each
item.description: Order two or more menu items from eligible pizzas, pastas, sandwiches, and more at $6.99 each when you mix and match — order online or in the app. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-09
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
